claim: Account promotion-contract native fixture at frozen inputs; no wrapper or immutable aggregate qualification

summary.claim: Only this bounded selection; no native aggregate or release qualification.

limits: Exactly three complete native cases run under promotion-contract-native-fixture. Internal directed populations are thirteen stage/version carriers (v1 through v9), ten semantic source/budget/collision inputs under one source-guard omission, and three HMAC-message omissions. These are not separate reporter cases. Existing 180-second native wrapper/file allowance, 60-second case limits, 15-second CDP startup and 5-second drain grace remain unchanged.

The fixture creates real synthetic Local custody, registers a synthetic Account, confirms recovery and prepares promotion using the existing owned-CDP context and temporary loopback service. Test-only exports expose macKey and retryDigest in in-memory Vite bundles. Direct IndexedDB installation replaces only the disposable marker row; each input starts by restoring the saved prepared marker. No personal state or product source is changed.

The version case creates MAC-valid records with each fixture stage/version and requires the owned readPromotion reader to return that stage. Changing the record ID afterward must cause the exact authentication failure. Genesis/admission/handoff payloads are synthetic fixture substitutions, not completed service-authorized stage transitions. The reader checks MAC and source binding here; the test does not establish nested service proof authorization, Account index selection or editor/cold writing reconstruction. Exercising the shared reader's v8 carrier grammar does not restore retired-v8 product support.

The semantic case recomputes a correct MAC for each lie: six source identifiers, claimMac, custodyMac, sealReserved and credential collision. Current code must reject with Promotion source or budget changed; an in-memory omission of that single guard must return prepared for each input. The source-generation comparison is present in the guard but is not an independently varied native input. The guard/export anchors are unique in the reviewed current sources.

The message case authenticates encodings that omit the marker ID, pending confirmation receipt ID or v9 handoff destination promotion ID. Baseline reads must fail authentication. A test hook removes the same field from the verification message and delegates to the original WebCrypto verifier; read must then return the expected stage and the interception count must be positive. It does not force verification to return true. The verify hook is restored in finally.

Integration repaired a control weakness: prefixing the pending receipt ID with a fixed a could leave the value unchanged. All three omitted bindings now toggle their first character and assert inequality. The pending case deliberately starts with a before signing, making the old no-op edge deterministic on every native run. A retained source-extraction check with seed 140902 reproduces the old failure and passes 160 generated sets afterward using valid-width receipt/hex identifier alphabets. This is fixture hardening, not a production protocol defect.

The reproduction executes only the extracted binding-substitution statements from the committed old or current native source, with synthetic objects. The arbitrary generator covers both alphabet/extent preservation and actual change across three prefixes and three target paths. It is supplementary saved evidence; the native test itself retains the deterministic edge and inequality guard. No new native generated histories or crash cuts are added.

All reads use the same page; no page replacement, renderer/browser/service crash, profile restore or offline writing recovery is tested. Correct-MAC test rows are directly installed with access to synthetic root custody. Shared optional helper paths and the wrapper's generated format matrices, per-field vector omissions, broader regressions, reporting and reproduction remain separate. No historical source reader executes in this selection.

All 93 pure runner checks, TypeScript and scoped style/planning/authority/signature checks pass. Unchanged Node-owner/native-owner controls (23/14) and five Vitest-process controls retain prior evidence. Product, fixture owner/runtime helpers, wrapper and interpreter remain unchanged; only the native binding-substitution assertions, runner integration and docs change. All 197 prior general contracts and 1658 identities, 52 personal/vector pins, L-2 and historical evidence remain unchanged. Ledger orphan classification, core receive/delivery-oracle headroom, capture oracle follow-ups and prior deadline evidence remain open. This frozen-input selection with an uncommitted patch is not immutable aggregate qualification.

timing.note: The file bound applies to Node execution. Stage and selection totals additionally include preparation, fingerprinting and drain. One passing run does not qualify loaded-host reliability.

deadlines.note: Existing wrapper and case limits retained; no allowances changed.
